enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +11: Passive: +11 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Potency +49: Passive: +49 Equipment bonus to each Spell Power.
Insightful Potency +24: Passive: +24 Insightful bonus to each Spell Power.
Quality Spell Focus Mastery +1: +1 Quality bonus to the DC of all spells.
Quality Spell Penetration +1: Passive: +1 Quality bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Equipoised Focus: Your two-handed weapon gains a +2 Exceptional focus to Spell DCs and is considered an Implement.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
